terms.summary: Authors keep the copyright in their Internet-Drafts (RFC 5378 §3.6); the IETF Trust may sublicense. TLP 5.0 §3.c allows copying and distributing a Contribution in full and without modification, or unmodified portions with attribution, but only for Contributions submitted after 2015-03-25 and not where a draft's own legend forbids it. Drafts are fetched by the reader onto a volume; none is shipped in an image.

drafts.name: draft-ietf-sidrops-8210bis
drafts.why: RPKI-to-Router protocol version 2 and the ASPA PDU: the specification rtrkit implements beyond RFC 8210.

drafts.name: draft-ietf-sidrops-aspa-profile
drafts.why: The ASPA signed-object profile that draft-ietf-sidrops-8210bis section 1.2 cites for the ASPA PDU; no portfolio row names it yet.

drafts.name: draft-ietf-sidrops-aspa-verification
drafts.why: ASPA-based AS_PATH verification. RFC 9774 section 9.2 cites it as a Work in Progress.

drafts.name: draft-koch-librepgp
drafts.why: LibrePGP message format, an extension of OpenPGP (RFC 4880, 5581, 6637, all since obsoleted by RFC 9580, which is a different line): what pgpenv needs for LibrePGP.

drafts.name: draft-uberti-behave-turn-rest
drafts.why: A REST API for obtaining ephemeral TURN credentials. The datatracker shows it expired in 2014, neither replaced nor published as an RFC.
